name: Gekkeikan
about: Gekkeikan brews in Fushimi, the sake district in the south of Kyoto, and its head office has stood there since the start. The Okura family opened a sake shop in 1637, after moving from Kasagi upstream on the Kizu River, and traded as Kasagiya.

The Gekkeikan name was registered as a trademark in 1905. In 1909 the 11th head, Tsunekichi Okura, founded the first research laboratory run by a sake maker, and the company went on to sell sake bottled without preservatives. It became a limited company in 1927 and is now led by the 14th head.
